title: 致醫界通函第 615 號：登革熱 NS1 抗原快篩試劑配置更新
summary: 自 2026-09-22 起更新登革熱 NS1 快篩試劑配置：南部疫區基層診所加量配置、改由線上系統申領，快篩陽性仍應 24 小時內通報。（原型示意通函，號次非真實）
bodyMarkdown:
一、因應南部登革熱本土疫情上升，疾管署自 2026 年 9 月 22 日起更新 NS1 抗原快速診斷試劑配置。
二、高雄市、台南市、屏東縣疫情區之基層診所配置量提高為每院所 40 劑，其他縣市維持 20 劑；不足時得向轄區衛生局追加。
三、申領方式改由「防疫物資管理資訊系統」線上申請，原紙本申請單停止使用。
四、依「登革熱／屈公病防治工作指引」第五章，快篩陽性者應於 24 小時內通報；快篩陰性但臨床高度懷疑者，仍應採檢送驗。

en.title: Letter to the Medical Community No. 615: updated allocation of dengue NS1 antigen rapid test kits
en.summary: From 22 September 2026 the allocation of dengue NS1 rapid test kits is updated: primary care clinics in the affected southern areas receive more kits, kits are requested through an online system, and positive rapid tests must still be reported within 24 hours. (Illustrative prototype letter; the letter number is not real.)
en.bodyMarkdown:
1. In response to rising local dengue transmission in southern Taiwan, Taiwan CDC is updating the allocation of NS1 antigen rapid diagnostic test kits from 22 September 2026.
2. The allocation for primary care clinics in affected areas of Kaohsiung City, Tainan City and Pingtung County is increased to 40 kits per clinic; other counties and cities remain at 20 kits. If more are needed, clinics may request additional kits from their local health bureau.
3. Kits are now requested online through the "Epidemic Prevention Supplies Management Information System"; the previous paper request form is no longer used.
4. Under Chapter 5 of the "Dengue/Chikungunya Control Guidelines", a positive rapid test must be reported within 24 hours; if the rapid test is negative but clinical suspicion is high, a specimen should still be collected and sent for testing.
